global: This shoyu ramen features a clear, amber broth with visible oil droplets. Topped with nori, bean sprouts, and chashu, it sits in a white bowl on a dark surface, lit softly from above.

regions.background: Dark brown wooden table surface with subtle grain patterns and smooth, slightly reflective finish.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with smooth, glossy surface, slightly raised rim, and subtle speckles near base.
regions.soup: Shoyu ramen broth, golden-brown, textured with visible oil droplets and floating bean sprouts, appears rich and savory.
regions.spoon: White ceramic spoon with smooth, glossy surface, slightly curved bowl, and faint yellowish stain near tip.
regions.seaweed: The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, rectangular with slightly uneven edges and visible surface ridges.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slice shows tender, slightly fatty texture with browned surface and visible marbling, cut into thick, irregular shape.
